Advice you can put to work

Your boss has asked for something you have never done. Or you have a decision to make and sixteen tabs open about it. Tell FAiRY what is going on: get advice now, and learn how to ask your own AI for help next time.
We’re businesswomen. We have a special. Let the paper fortune teller pick your drink—cocktail or spirit-free—then give the group chat something to discuss in person.
Just Call · experimental game also available

Remember Dream Phone and the hunt for your secret crush? We brought it to SUNNYVAiLE. Just Call for a playful bit of advice from someone who would have written more than “Have a great summer!” in your yearbook. The full game is still experimental.
Truth or dare · with your girls
The sleepover classic has grown up with you. Play truth or dare privately, or visit Delta LAi Nu to find the community rooms. Posting in the rooms has its own sign-in.
Your technical AI question desk

AI has given you enough new things to figure out. You do not need to guess which bookshelf the answer lives on, too. Ask in plain language and Miss Jeeves will look through LAiDIES for answers and places to read more.
Miss Jeeves is in beta. She works best with questions covered by LAiDIES. Check the sources she gives you; broader AI answers are still being improved.

Work and career advice; help using your own AI
Ready to make it official? Create your Resident Card at MAiKEOVER on MAiN. It is your SUNNYVAiLE town ID and gives you your own Closet—a place for your Card and the keepsakes you collect around town.
Then visit Delta LAi Nu, SUNNYVAiLE’s sorority house and community home. Explore the rooms, join the conversation and try Girl Talk—our private spin on classic ’90s truth or dare.
Your Card and keepsakes begin in this browser. Your Closet explains what is saved on this device and what is connected to your account.
